 THIS PETITION IS FILED UNDER ARTICLES 226 & 227 OF THE CONSTITUTION OF INDIA, PRAYING TO DECLARE THAT THE ACQUISITION COVERED UNDER THE PRELIMINARY NOTIFICATION ISSUED ON 21/03/1977, BEARING NO.
HC.PR.ALAO/389/BDA/76-77 ISSUED BY THE RESPONDENT NO.2 AS PER ANNEXURE-D AND ALSO THE FINAL NOTIFICATION DATED 12/06/1980, BEARING NO.
HUD/49/MNJ/78 AS PER ANNEXURE-E ISSUED BY THE RESPONDENT NO.2 IN RELATED TO LANDS OF THE PETITIONER ARE CONCERNED, IS LAPSED IN VIEW OF SECTION 27 OF THE BANGALORE DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY ACT, 1976 FOR FAILURE TO IMPLEMENT THE SCHEME, ETC.
 THIS PETITION COMING ON FOR PRELIMINARY HEARING IN 'B' GROUP, THROUGH PHYSICAL HEARING/VIDEO CONFERENCING THIS DAY, ORDER WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR JUSTICE M.I.ARUN  -3-  NC: 2024:KHC:37461  WP No. 14947 of 2024  ORAL ORDER 1.

The writ petition is filed in respect of acquisition of writ petition schedule property by the Bangalore Development Authority (BDA) which measures 6 acres 2 guntas of land in Sy.No.78,
Kacharakanahalli Village, Kasaba Hobli, Bangalore North Taluk.
However, in the course of the arguments, the same is confined to 5 acres 17 guntas of land.

sentences.text: The case of the petitioner is that a preliminary notification in respect of the land concerned was issued on 21.03.1977 and a final notification was issued on 12.06.1980.
However, thereafter award was passed only in respect of 25 guntas of land on 31.03.1999 and the compensation is received by the petitioner.
However, in respect of 5 acres 17 guntas of land no award has been passed nor possession has been taken.
On the said ground, it is prayed that the preliminary and final notifications in respect of 5 acres 17 guntas of land be set aside.
Learned counsel appearing for respondent Nos.2 and 3 is not in a position to contravene the submissions of learned counsel for the petitioner made above.
4. Admittedly, inspite of preliminary and final notifications being issued, no award has been passed and possession of the land has not been taken so far.

In umpteen number of cases, this Court has held that though Bangalore Development Authority Act, 1976 does not specify the time limit within which the award has to be passed and possession has to be taken, the acquisition proceedings has to be completed within a reasonable period failing which the same is liable to be set aside.

The reason for the same is that the petitioner is entitled to compensation as per the value of the land as on the date of issuance of preliminary notification and in the instant case, the petitioner cannot be forced to accept the compensation for the land as on 1977 and it would be unjust.
For the said reason, the preliminary and final NC: 2024:KHC:37461 notifications are liable to be set aside and hence, the following order is passed:
O R D E R i . T h e p r e l i m i n a r y n o t i f i c a t i o n d a t e d 2 1 .

0 3 . 1 9 7 7 b e a r i n g No.HC.PR.ALAO/389/BDA/76-77 and final notification dated 12.06.1980 bearing No.HUD/49/MNJ/78 issued insofar as it relates to the land of the petitioner for which no award has been passed and possession is not taken by BDA, are hereby set aside.
ii. The writ petition is disposed of accordingly.

Sd/-
